# Design brief pack — 2026-06-22 (hero batch)

A snapshot of brief + screenshot pairs for the highest-value ART-EEP screens, for handoff to
**claude.ai/design**. Generated by Claude Code from the live mockup; **regenerate when the
mockup changes** — this is a point-in-time snapshot, not living truth.

**Last refreshed:** 2026-06-23 — offboarder restructure: the offboarder Dashboard is now their
**session command view** (minimal sidebar; Overview tab = the question-queue dashboard; Data tab
= a flat answerable queue). Re-captured `dashboard-offboarder-active-queue` +
`session-offboarder-capture-overview` and added `session-offboarder-capture-data`; their briefs
were regenerated. (Earlier on 2026-06-22 the 2 KG screens were refreshed after the gap-resolution
change.) Manager screens are unchanged.

> **Note — login is now role-select (no password).** To re-capture a role's screen, set the
> `mockup_role` cookie / sign in as that role first; the topbar chrome and sidebar follow the
> login role (offboarder = minimal sidebar). The in-app role switcher was removed.

## What's here
- `screens/<id>.png` — full-page screenshot of each state (1440×900 viewport), captured from
  the running app.
- `briefs/<id>.md` — the brief for that state (layout + content + design-system contracts),
  written per `design-briefs/RECIPE.md`.
- `manifest.md` — the list of states in this pack and the exact URL each was captured from.

## How the designer uses it
For each screen: open `briefs/<id>.md` + `screens/<id>.png`, attach both to claude.ai/design,
and use the reproduce-don't-reinvent prompt (top of each brief). Then export → HTML → (Claude
Desktop) use-figma. See `design-briefs/DESIGNER-GUIDE.md`.

## How this pack was generated (for whoever regenerates it)
- State list + URLs come straight from **`lib/view-matrix.ts`** — the app's declarative source
  of truth (`sessionUrl()`, `dashboardUrl()`, `FLOWS`). Every state is URL-addressable, so
  screenshots need no clicking.
- This is the **hero batch** (~10 representative archetypes), not all ~87 canonical states.
  The long tail is deferred until this batch's quality is validated in claude.ai/design.

### Gotcha for regeneration — role chrome follows a cookie, not the URL
The `?role=` URL param drives the **page content**, but the topbar **role pill + State
switcher** read the `mockup_role` cookie (set at login — the in-app "View as" switcher was
removed; role now comes only from the login role-select). So when
capturing offboarder/coworker states, set the cookie first or the chrome will still show the
manager (Hà Vy). In Playwright: `document.cookie = "mockup_role=offboarder;path=/"` then
navigate. The manager states need no change (manager is the default cookie).
